The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the PID activation process verifies, through the authentication mechanism established during Wallet Unit Activation, that the Wallet User completing the activation is the same individual who initiated PID issuance, before the Wallet Unit transitions to a state in which PID presentation is permitted.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 62](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=62)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's technical documentation of the activation flow and confirming that it requires a fresh authentication event bound to the Wallet Unit's established authentication mechanism and that no alternative pathway to activation exists. Where feasible, the CAB may also attempt to activate a PID on a test Wallet Unit while bypassing or substituting the



### PID-8.5-02 {#pid-8-5-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires the Wallet User's explicit confirmation before marking a received PID credential as active and available for presentation to relying parties.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 63](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=63)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented activation behaviour and confirming that a delivered PID cannot be presented until the Wallet User has explicitly confirmed activation. Where feasible, the CAB may also deliver a test PID to a Wallet Unit and confirm that it cannot be presented until the Wallet User has explicitly confirmed activation.



## 9.1 Software Updates and Patches

[Read section 9.1 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-9-1)

### MAINT-9.1-01 {#maint-9-1-01}

The Wallet Provider shall apply the same documented change-control, codesigning, and distribution-channel controls to every Wallet Instance software update as those required for initial deployment, such that no update bypasses or relaxes the controls established for the original software release.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 64](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=64)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the update history of the previous 12 months, by sampling change-records to confirm that signing, supply-chain, and operator-logging controls were applied to each, and by interviewing release engineers to confirm no informal expedited path exists outside the documented process.



### MAINT-9.1-02 {#maint-9-1-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each update to the Wallet Instance is verified, before deployment, to confirm that the update does not remove or reduce the operating system-level isolation mechanisms that protect data stored by the Wallet Instance from access by co-located applications, and shall refuse to apply an update that would reduce the Wallet Instance's isolation capabilities below the level verified during installation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 64](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=64)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's update verification procedure and confirming that the procedure explicitly includes a check for changes to application storage configuration, permissions, and inter-process communication interfaces. The CAB may additionally apply a test update that introduces an intentional weakening of isolation and confirm that the Wallet Provider's verification process detects and rejects such an update.



### MAINT-9.1-03 {#maint-9-1-03}

\[CONDITIONAL\] Where the Wallet Provider permits rollback to a previous software version of the Wallet Instance, the Wallet Provider shall ensure that the rollback does not result in the reinstatement of a version with known security vulnerabilities or a reduction of the security baseline established by the version in force before the rollback.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 65](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=65)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented rollback controls and confirming that rollback to a version with a known vulnerability is refused or constrained to a version that preserves the security baseline. Where feasible, the CAB may also attempt to roll back a test Wallet Instance to a version with a known vulnerability and confirm that the rollback is refused or so constrained.



### MAINT-9.1-04 — The Wallet Provider shall notify the Wallet User when an update to the Wallet Instance is available. {#maint-9-1-04}

The Wallet Provider shall notify the Wallet User when an update to the Wallet Instance is available.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 65](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=65)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's update-notification process and confirming that Wallet Users are informed when an update is available, for instance by examining the notification design and records of past notifications, and, where feasible, by observing a notification on a test device.



### MAINT-9.1-05 {#maint-9-1-05}

\[CONDITIONAL\] Where an update to the Wallet Instance remediates a security vulnerability or is necessary to maintain the security baseline of the Wallet Unit, the Wallet Provider shall make the installation of that update a precondition for continued use of the Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 66](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=66)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's update policy and its classification of security-remediating updates, and confirming that such an update is made a precondition for continued use, for instance by examining the enforcement design and records of a past mandatory update, and, where feasible, by confirming on a test device that the Wallet Unit does not continue to operate on the superseded version once such an update is available.



## 9.2 Re-authentication and Session Management

[Read section 9.2 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-9-2)

### MAINT-9.2-01 {#maint-9-2-01}

The Wallet Provider shall define and enforce a maximum inactivity period after which an authenticated session within the Wallet Unit is automatically invalidated and the Wallet User is required to re-authenticate before any Wallet Unit operation may proceed.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 66](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=66)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented session timeout design and confirming that an operation after the defined idle period requires reauthentication. Where feasible, the CAB may also leave a test Wallet Unit idle past the defined period and confirm that a subsequent operation requires re-authentication.



### MAINT-9.2-02 {#maint-9-2-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires Wallet User re-authentication before performing any sensitive operation, including presentation of credentials to a relying party, modification of enrolled authentication factors, and access to stored PID or attestation data following session expiry.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 67](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=67)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented session handling and confirming that each listed operation on a Wallet Unit with an expired session requires re-authentication before it proceeds. Where feasible, the CAB may also attempt each listed operation on a Wallet Unit with an expired session and confirm that reauthentication is required before it proceeds.



### MAINT-9.2-03 {#maint-9-2-03}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit does not retain PID data or other personal data in unprotected memory or storage beyond the scope of a single presentation transaction, and that any temporary copies of such data created during a transaction are securely erased upon completion or termination of that transaction.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 67](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=67)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Unit’s data handling implementation for presentation flows and confirming that personal data is not retained in application-layer storage after the transaction. The CAB also tests this by inspecting device memory state or application storage after a completed presentation transaction.



## 9.3 Key Rotation and Renewal

[Read section 9.3 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-9-3)

### MAINT-9.3-01 {#maint-9-3-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all cryptographic key material subject to rotation is generated within the WSCD and remains within the WSCD throughout the key rotation process, and that superseded key material is irrevocably deleted from the WSCD upon successful completion of rotation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 68](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=68)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the key rotation implementation and confirming that key generation occurs within the WSCD, that key material does not pass through application-layer code in plaintext during rotation, and that completion of rotation is confirmed before the superseded key is deleted.



### MAINT-9.3-02 {#maint-9-3-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that key rotation and Wallet Unit software update operations are performed in a manner that preserves the security level of the Wallet Unit throughout the operation, such that no transient or permanent reduction in cryptographic strength occurs, and that any operation that cannot be completed without reducing security is automatically aborted and the Wallet Unit restored to its pre-operation security state.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 68](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=68)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the key rotation and update procedure documentation and confirming that the procedure specifies the conditions under which a rollback is triggered and how the restoration of the pre-operation state is verified. Where feasible, the CAB may also test failure scenarios, such as interrupting the rotation at different stages, and confirm that the Wallet Unit remains fully operational at the original security level after each aborted attempt.



### MAINT-9.3-03 {#maint-9-3-03}

The Wallet Provider shall implement and document procedures for renewing Wallet Instance Attestations and Key Attestations before their expiry date and shall ensure that the expiry of such an attestation does not cause an unplanned interruption to Wallet Unit availability.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 69](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=69)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the renewal procedure and its timing and by confirming, on a test Wallet Unit, that an attestation approaching expiry is renewed before availability is affected.



### MAINT-9.3-04 {#maint-9-3-04}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that renewal of the Wallet Instance Attestation and the Key Attestation and re-issuance of PID credentials and Electronic Attestations of Attributes during the maintenance phase applies the same security controls, cryptographic key generation procedures, and assurance requirements as the initial issuance process for the same credential type, and shall not implement a renewal path that bypasses or reduces any security requirement that applied during initial issuance.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 69](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=69)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented renewal procedures for each credential type and confirming that each renewal step is equivalent to the corresponding initial issuance step with no steps omitted or simplified. The CAB may additionally perform a renewal in a test environment, inspect the resulting credential and audit log, and confirm that all required security steps were completed and logged at the same level of evidence as an initial issuance.



## 9.4 PID and EAA Lifecycle Management

[Read section 9.4 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-9-4)

### MAINT-9.4-01 {#maint-9-4-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon expiry of the validity period of a PID credential or Electronic Attestation of Attributes, the Wallet Unit refuses to present the expired credential to any Relying Party.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 70](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=70)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented validity-checking behaviour and confirming that the Wallet Unit refuses to present an expired credential to a Relying Party. Where feasible, the CAB may also issue a test credential with a short validity period, advance the system clock past the expiry date, and confirm that the Wallet Unit refuses to present the expired credential to a test Relying Party.



### MAINT-9.4-02 {#maint-9-4-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon revocation of a PID credential or Electronic Attestation of Attributes by its Provider, the Wallet Unit refuses to present the revoked credential to any Relying Party, and shall implement a mechanism to check and maintain awareness of the revocation status of all PID credentials and Electronic Attestations of Attributes stored in the Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 70](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=70)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented revocation-checking architecture and confirming it is appropriate for each credential format and Provider in use and that a revoked credential is detected within the documented maximum staleness interval and no longer presented. Where feasible, the CAB may also revoke a test PID credential or Electronic Attestation of Attributes on the Provider's system while the Wallet Unit holds a valid copy and confirm that the Wallet Unit detects the revocation within that interval and subsequently refuses to present the credential.



### MAINT-9.4-03 {#maint-9-4-03}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit clearly indicates the expired or revoked status of any PID credential or Electronic Attestation of Attributes in any Wallet User interface that displays the credential.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 71](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=71)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Unit's user interface design and confirming that expired and revoked states are each clearly indicated to the Wallet User and that the indicators distinguish between expired and revoked status. Where feasible, the CAB may also issue a test credential with a short validity period and separately revoke a test credential and confirm that both states are clearly and distinctly indicated in the Wallet User interface.



### MAINT-9.4-04 {#maint-9-4-04}

The Wallet Provider shall apply, to every renewal or re-issuance of a PID credential or Electronic Attestation of Attributes to the Wallet Unit, the same authentication, identity-proofing, and cryptographic-binding requirements as those required for the initial issuance of that credential type.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 72](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=72)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the renewal flow documentation, comparing the implementation steps of renewal and initial issuance to confirm equivalence, and sampling renewal records to confirm that fresh proofing assertions and fresh binding keys are present. Where feasible, the CAB may also attempt on a test Wallet Unit to initiate renewal of an expired PID without supplying fresh proofing and confirm that the renewal is refused.



### MAINT-9.4-05 {#maint-9-4-05}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit provides the Wallet User with the ability to delete individual attestations, and that deletion results in the removal of the credential data from the Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 72](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=72)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by deleting a test attestation and confirming that its data no longer resides in the Wallet Unit.



### MAINT-9.4-06 {#maint-9-4-06}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon deletion of a PID credential or an Electronic Attestation of Attributes from the Wallet Unit, every registration of that credential with an operating system interface through which relying parties can request its presentation is removed.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 73](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=73)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by deleting a credential on a test device and then querying the operating system presentation interface to confirm that the credential is no longer offered.



## 9.5 Wallet User Support

[Read section 9.5 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-9-5)

### MAINT-9.5-01 {#maint-9-5-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all Wallet User support processes for Wallet Unit-related requests include verification of the Wallet User's identity before any action affecting the Wallet Unit account is taken by support staff.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 73](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=73)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the support procedures and confirming that a support action affecting an account is refused until the Wallet User's identity has been verified. Where feasible, the CAB may also test that such a support action is refused until the Wallet User's identity has been verified.



### MAINT-9.5-02 {#maint-9-5-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that any process by which a Wallet User who is unable to authenticate using an existing enrolled authentication factor resets that authentication factor requires identity re-verification at an assurance level equivalent to the assurance level of the Wallet Unit before the reset is permitted.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 74](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=74)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented factor-reset process and confirming that it requires identity re-verification at an assurance level equivalent to the Wallet Unit's before the reset completes. Where feasible, the CAB may also exercise the factor-reset process and confirm that it requires such identity reverification before completing.



### MAINT-9.5-03 {#maint-9-5-03}

The Wallet Provider shall establish, maintain, and communicate to the Users a clear and accessible procedure through which a Wallet User can report the confirmed or suspected loss or theft of the device hosting the Wallet Unit without requiring physical access to the original device.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 74](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=74)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented notification procedure and confirming that: the procedure does not require the original device; the procedure is communicated to Users at Wallet Unit activation; and the procedure leads to revocation of the Wallet Unit without unreasonable delay.



### MAINT-9.5-04 {#maint-9-5-04}

The Wallet Provider shall, upon receiving a credible report of loss or theft of the device hosting a Wallet Unit, revoke that Wallet Unit promptly and prior to establishing any replacement Wallet Unit for the same Wallet User.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 74](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=74)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented revocation procedure for lost and stolen devices and confirming that: revocation precedes any replacement issuance; the defined maximum revocation interval is respected; and revocation is verified in a conformance test scenario.



### MAINT-9.5-05 {#maint-9-5-05}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the process for establishing a replacement Wallet Unit following a confirmed or suspected compromise of the existing Wallet Unit or its authentication factors applies the same security requirements as the initial installation and activation process, including identity verification at the applicable Assurance Level for each credential type to be re-issued.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 75](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=75)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider’s documented replacement procedure and confirming that each step required during initial activation is also required during replacement. The CAB may also simulate a replacement scenario and verify that the Wallet Provider does not offer any shortcut path to reissuance that would omit required verification steps.

**Referenced by:** [MAINT-9.5-06](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-5-06)

### MAINT-9.5-06 {#maint-9-5-06}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a revocation of a Wallet Unit, or the establishment of a replacement Wallet Unit under [MAINT-9.5-05](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-5-05), that support staff carry out on behalf of a Wallet User takes effect only after a second member of staff has approved it.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 75](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=75)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the support procedure and the tooling and by examining a sample of cases.

**Referenced by:** [MAINT-9.5-07](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-5-07), [MAINT-9.5-08](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-5-08)

### MAINT-9.5-07 {#maint-9-5-07}

The Wallet Provider shall record the two approvals under [MAINT-9.5-06](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-5-06) in a log that is protected against undetected modification.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 76](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=76)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the logging design and by examining log samples.



### MAINT-9.5-08 {#maint-9-5-08}

The Wallet Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum time within which the second approval under [MAINT-9.5-06](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-5-06) is given.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 76](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=76)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the risk assessment and the documented maximum time.

**Referenced by:** [MAINT-9.5-09](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-5-09)

### MAINT-9.5-09 {#maint-9-5-09}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the second approval under MAINT9.5-06 is given within the maximum time determined under [MAINT-9.5-08](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-5-08).

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 76](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=76)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the monitoring and by examining records of approval times.



## 9.6 Backup and Restore

[Read section 9.6 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-9-6)

### MAINT-9.6-01 {#maint-9-6-01}

The Wallet Provider shall document the scope and limitations of the Wallet Unit backup mechanism (the Migration Object), including which data elements are included in and excluded from the backup, and shall communicate these limitations to the Wallet User before the Wallet User activate the automated backup creation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 76](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=76)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the backup documentation and confirming, in the Wallet User flow, that the limitations are communicated before automated backup is activated.



### MAINT-9.6-02 {#maint-9-6-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that any backup is encrypted before being stored or transmitted outside the Wallet Unit, using an encryption password that is known only to the Wallet User.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 77](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=77)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the backup implementation and confirming that PID and attestation data is encrypted before being stored or transmitted outside the Wallet Unit, that the backup encryption key is stored separately from the backup data, and that the encryption key itself is protected with access controls appropriate to its sensitivity.



### MAINT-9.6-03 {#maint-9-6-03}

The Wallet Provider shall inform the Wallet User that the encryption password should be stored separately from the backup in a location that is only accessible to the Wallet User.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 77](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=77)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by confirming that the Wallet User is informed, as part of the backup flow, to store the encryption password separately from the backup.



### MAINT-9.6-04 {#maint-9-6-04}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the confidentiality of the backup data does not depend on the storage location, such that the backup remains unreadable to the Wallet Provider and to the operator of any storage location offered or used, and the ability to decrypt it rests solely on a secret held by the Wallet User.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 77](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=77)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the backup key-management design and confirming that decryption depends only on a Wallet-User-held secret and that neither the Wallet Provider nor any offered storage operator holds that secret, for instance by inspecting the key-management documentation and, where feasible, by retrieving a stored backup and confirming no plaintext is recoverable without the user secret.



### MAINT-9.6-05 {#maint-9-6-05}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that when a Wallet User restores a backup to a different device the target Wallet Unit will remind the Wallet User to revoke the source Wallet Unit if it will no longer be used by the Wallet User and provide him with any information that the Wallet Provider may collect that would help the Wallet User to do so.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 78](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=78)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented restore flow and confirming that, on restoring a backup to a new device, the Wallet User is reminded to revoke the old Wallet Unit and given the available supporting information. Where feasible, the CAB may also restore a backup to a new test device and confirm that the reminder and supporting information are provided.



### MAINT-9.6-06 {#maint-9-6-06}

The Wallet Provider shall update the Migration Object to reflect the current state of all PID credentials, attestations, and transaction log entries after every transaction performed by the Wallet Unit. A transaction for the purposes of this requirement includes any presentation of a PID or EAA to a relying party, any issuance or deletion of an attestation, and any key rotation event.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 78](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=78)



### MAINT-9.6-07 {#maint-9-6-07}

The Wallet Provider shall not present a Migration Object to the Wallet User as current if the Migration Object does not reflect the most recently confirmed wallet state, without displaying an accompanying notification that the Migration Object is outdated.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 79](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=79)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by examining a test Wallet Unit whose Migration Object update timestamp predates the most recently confirmed transaction, and confirming that: (i) the object is not displayed to the Wallet User as current or up to date; (ii) the staleness notification is displayed and includes the last update timestamp; (iii) the notification cannot be dismissed in a way that causes the object to subsequently appear as a current backup.



### MAINT-9.6-08 {#maint-9-6-08}

\[CONDITIONAL\] The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, where the Wallet Unit cannot update the Migration Object because the storage location selected by the Wallet User is no longer accessible to it, the Wallet Unit prompts the Wallet User to restore access to that location or to select a new storage location.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 79](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=79)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Unit's handling of a failed Migration Object update and confirming that an inaccessible location leads to a Wallet User prompt to restore access or choose a new location, for instance by inspecting the error-handling design and, where feasible, by making the selected location unreachable on a test device and observing the prompt.



## 9.7 Security and Compliance Monitoring

[Read section 9.7 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-9-7)

### MAINT-9.7-01 {#maint-9-7-01}

The Wallet Provider shall monitor the continued adequacy of the authentication factors associated with each Wallet Unit for the applicable Assurance Level and shall require the Wallet User to establish new or updated authentication factors — through a process that meets the same security requirements as the initial activation — where the operating system, Wallet Secure Cryptographic Device, or applicable conformity framework indicates that existing factors no longer meet the requirements for the applicable Assurance Level.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 80](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=80)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's monitoring procedures and confirming that the procedure covers all conditions under which authentication factors may become inadequate, that the procedure triggers an update requirement when any monitored condition is detected, and that the update process applies the same security requirements as initial activation. The CAB may additionally present a Wallet Unit whose WSCD attestation has expired (if available) and confirm that the Wallet Unit requires re-attestation before presentations are permitted.



### MAINT-9.7-02 {#maint-9-7-02}

The Wallet Provider shall conduct documented periodic reviews of the security controls and procedures governing the Wallet Unit infrastructure, at intervals not exceeding twelve months, to verify that the controls remain effective and continue to satisfy the requirements for the applicable Assurance Level, and shall document identified findings and implement remediation within a timeframe commensurate with the severity of each finding.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 81](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=81)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documentation of recent security reviews and confirming that: (i) reviews have been conducted at intervals not exceeding twelve months; (ii) findings are documented with severity ratings; (iii) remediation has been completed within the defined timeframes or escalated with documented justification. The CAB also reviews the most recent security review report to assess its scope and confirm that it covers the areas specified in this requirement.



## 9.8 Data Management and Retention

[Read section 9.8 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-9-8)

### MAINT-9.8-01 {#maint-9-8-01}

The Wallet Provider shall maintain a documented data management policy that specifies, for each category of operational record generated during the Wallet Unit's active lifetime, the legal basis for retention, the defined retention period, the storage protection requirements, and the deletion or anonymisation mechanism, and shall implement and consistently apply this policy across all Wallet Units and associated backend systems.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 81](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=81)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented data management policy and confirming that: (i) all operational record categories are enumerated with documented legal basis, retention period, storage protection requirements, and deletion mechanism for each; (ii) the policy is implemented and consistently applied across all systems. The CAB may additionally inspect records for a sample of active Wallet Units to verify that retention periods and protection requirements are applied in accordance with the documented policy.



## 9.9 Trust Anchor Management

[Read section 9.9 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-9-9)

### MAINT-9.9-01 {#maint-9-9-01}

The Wallet Provider shall retrieve, at intervals not exceeding 24 hours, the current version of each trusted list as specified in \[8\] and of each list of trusted entities established in accordance with \[12\] that is applicable to the parties with which its Wallet Units interact.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 82](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=82)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the retrieval schedule and its monitoring, and by sampling the retrieval logs over a representative period to confirm that the interval was respected and that failures were followed up.

**Referenced by:** [MAINT-9.9-02](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-9-02), [MAINT-9.9-03](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-9-03)

### MAINT-9.9-02 {#maint-9-9-02}

The Wallet Provider shall distribute to every non-revoked Wallet Unit each trust anchor that has been newly published in a list retrieved under [MAINT-9.9-01](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-9-01).

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 82](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=82)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by observing, on a test Wallet Unit, that an anchor newly added to a source list becomes available to the Wallet Unit, and by reviewing the distribution mechanism and its integrity protection.

**Referenced by:** [MAINT-9.9-04](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-9-04)

### MAINT-9.9-03 {#maint-9-9-03}

The Wallet Provider shall withdraw from every valid Wallet Unit each trust anchor that has been removed from, or invalidated in, a list retrieved under [MAINT-9.9-01](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-9-01).

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 83](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=83)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by removing an anchor from a source list, confirming on a test Wallet Unit that credentials authenticated under it are subsequently refused, and by reviewing the records of Wallet Units that have not yet confirmed the withdrawal.



### MAINT-9.9-04 {#maint-9-9-04}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a Wallet Unit accepts only the trust anchors distributed to it by the Wallet Provider under [MAINT-9.9-02](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#maint-9-9-02).

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 84](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=84)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by adding an anchor to the operating system trust store of a test device and confirming that material authenticated under that anchor is not accepted by the Wallet Unit.



## 10.1 Migration Initiation and Authorisation

[Read section 10.1 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-10-1)

### MIG-10.1-01 {#mig-10-1-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that migration of a Wallet Unit is initiated solely by the Wallet User from the source Wallet Unit, including where the target Wallet Unit is operated by a different Wallet Provider, and that no authorisation, approval, or notification by the Wallet Provider is required as a precondition for initiating migration.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 85](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=85)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by inspecting the Wallet Unit Wallet User interface for a Wallet User-accessible migration trigger and reviewing the Wallet Provider's documentation for any policy or procedure that would gate Wallet User-initiated migration, confirming that no Wallet-Provider-side authorisation or approval step is required. Where feasible, the CAB may also initiate migration on a test Wallet Unit and confirm that no such authorisation or approval step is encountered.



## 10.2 Secure Data Transfer Mechanisms

[Read section 10.2 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-10-2)

### MIG-10.2-01 {#mig-10-2-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that at all times an updated Migration Object will be available in the storage location selected by the Wallet User.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 85](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=85)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by changing the contents of a test Wallet Unit and confirming that the Migration Object in the selected storage location is updated to reflect the change.



### MIG-10.2-02 {#mig-10-2-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Migration Object is stored in external or remote storage only in an encrypted form that protects its confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity, and that only the Wallet User holds the cryptographic material required to decrypt it.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 86](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=86)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by retrieving a stored Migration Object from the external or remote storage location and confirming that it is stored in an encrypted form from which no plaintext data is recoverable without the Wallet User's secret. The CAB additionally reviews the Wallet Provider's documentation to confirm that the decryption key is not stored on or derivable by the Wallet Provider's infrastructure, and that no Wallet Provider-side pathway exists to access the plaintext content of the Migration Object.



### MIG-10.2-03 {#mig-10-2-03}

Prior to presenting the Wallet User with the option to finalise migration and revoke the source Wallet Unit, the Wallet Provider shall verify that the target Wallet Unit is in an active state.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 86](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=86)



### MIG-10.2-04 {#mig-10-2-04}

The Wallet Provider shall revoke the source Wallet Unit upon the Wallet User’s explicit decision to finalise the migration.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 87](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=87)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented migration flow and its logging and confirming that: (1) the finalisation screen describes the revocation consequence in clear terms; (2) revocation is recorded in the migration log with the authenticated Wallet User session timestamp. Where feasible, the CAB may also test the migration flow to confirm this behaviour.



### MIG-10.2-05 {#mig-10-2-05}

The Wallet Provider shall not prevent or delay revocation of the source Wallet Unit on the grounds that the Wallet User has not yet requested reissuance of some or all Electronic Attestations of Attributes held in the source Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 87](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=87)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented finalisation behaviour and confirming that, when a test Wallet Unit has at least one EAA not yet reissued on the target device: (i) the Wallet Provider does not prevent the Wallet User from selecting the finalisation action; (ii) revocation of the source Wallet Unit proceeds upon the Wallet User's finalisation decision regardless of the EAA reissuance status on the target device. Where feasible, the CAB may also attempt to finalise migration in this state and confirm this behaviour.



## 10.3 New Device Security Verification

[Read section 10.3 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-10-3)

### MIG-10.3-01 {#mig-10-3-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, before completing Wallet Unit reestablishment on the target device, the target device undergoes the same device security assessment as is required during Wallet Instance installation, including verification that the device meets the minimum hardware and software security requirements defined in the Wallet Provider's security policy and that a WSCD meeting the applicable security certification requirements is available on the target device.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 88](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=88)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented migration security criteria and confirming that the migration flow refuses to complete Wallet Unit reestablishment on a target device that fails one or more of the security criteria required during installation - for example, a device with a non-certified WSCD or a device showing indicators of operating system compromise - and that the source Wallet Unit remains active. Where feasible, the CAB may also present such a target device and confirm that re-establishment is refused and the source Wallet Unit remains active.



## 10.4 Wallet Unit Re-establishment on New Device

[Read section 10.4 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-10-4)

### MIG-10.4-01 {#mig-10-4-01}

The Wallet Provider shall issue a new Wallet Instance Attestation and a new Key Attestation for the new device following the same security verification process applied during their initial issuance, including WSCD certification verification and platform attestation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 89](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=89)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented migration flow and confirming that new attestations are issued only after the same verification steps as initial issuance. Where feasible, the CAB may also perform a migration to a test device and confirm that new attestations are issued only after those same verification steps.



### MIG-10.4-02 {#mig-10-4-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that device binding on the new device is established using a key pair newly generated within the WSCD of the new device and that no device-bound private key is transferred from the old device to the new device.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 89](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=89)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by inspecting a migration and confirming that the new device's binding keys were generated on that device and that no device-bound private key was transferred from the old device.



### MIG-10.4-03 {#mig-10-4-03}

The Wallet Provider shall require the Wallet User to establish authentication factors on the target device through a procedure that meets the same security requirements as the initial setup of authentication factors during Wallet Unit activation, prior to the migration process being considered complete.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 89](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=89)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the technical specification of the migration flow and confirming that authentication factor setup on the target device is a mandatory, documented step subject to the same security controls as initial activation. The CAB also tests that authentication on the target device uses factors freshly established on that device, and not any credentials transferred from the source device.



## 10.5 Old Device Decommissioning

[Read section 10.5 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-10-5)

### MIG-10.5-01 {#mig-10-5-01}

The Wallet Provider shall point out the dangers to the Wallet User of a valid Wallet Unit that is not under control of the Wallet User and ask the Wallet User if the old Wallet Unit should be revoked.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 90](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=90)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented decommissioning flow and confirming that the risk is explained and that the Wallet User is asked whether to revoke the old Wallet Unit. Where feasible, the CAB may also run the decommissioning flow and confirm that the risk is explained and the Wallet User is asked whether to revoke the old Wallet Unit.



### MIG-10.5-02 {#mig-10-5-02}

\[CONDITIONAL\] If the Wallet User has indicated a need for the old Wallet Unit to be revoked and the old Wallet Unit is managed by the same Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall start the process to revoke the old Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 90](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=90)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by requesting revocation of an old Wallet Unit managed by the same Wallet Provider during decommissioning and confirming that revocation is initiated.



### MIG-10.5-03 {#mig-10-5-03}

\[CONDITIONAL\] If the Wallet User has indicated a need for the old Wallet Unit to be revoked and the old Wallet Unit is not managed by the same Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall give the best possible instructions to the Wallet User what actions the Wallet User should undertake in order to get the old Wallet Unit revoked.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 91](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=91)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by requesting revocation of an old Wallet Unit managed by a different provider and confirming that the Wallet User is given actionable instructions on how to obtain that revocation.



### MIG-10.5-04 {#mig-10-5-04}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all key material held by the WSCD, all PID credentials and Electronic Attestations of Attributes, and all personal data stored by the Wallet Instance are permanently and irrecoverably deleted from the device before the Wallet Instance uninstallation process completes.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 91](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=91)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's uninstallation procedure documentation and confirming that it specifies a defined deletion step for each category of stored data. Where a forensic examination is feasible, the CAB may also perform a guided uninstallation of a test Wallet Unit and conduct a forensic examination of the device storage to confirm that no recoverable credential data, key material, or personal data attributable to the wallet remains after uninstallation.



### MIG-10.5-05 {#mig-10-5-05}

\[CONDITIONAL\] If the Wallet User has indicated a need for the old Wallet Unit to be revoked and the old Wallet Unit is managed by the same Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall ensure that that all cryptographic key material and personal data stored in the old Wallet Unit are irrecoverably deleted from the old device and that the Wallet Instance is uninstalled from the old device the next time when the Wallet Instance connects again with the WSCA.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 92](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=92)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by revoking an old Wallet Unit and confirming that, on the old device's next reconnection, its key material and personal data are deleted and the Wallet Instance is uninstalled.



## 10.6 Secure Deletion of Keys and Attestations on Old Device

[Read section 10.6 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-10-6)

### MIG-10.6-01 {#mig-10-6-01}

The Wallet Provider shall verify that the deletion of all cryptographic key material and personal data from the source Wallet Unit has completed, and shall record the outcome of that verification.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 92](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=92)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented deletion-confirmation handling and confirming that the recorded verification outcome is marked unconfirmed when the source device is disconnected during deletion. Where feasible, the CAB may also complete a migration on test devices, inspect the recorded verification outcome, and repeat the migration with the source device disconnected during deletion to confirm that the outcome is recorded as unconfirmed.

**Referenced by:** [MIG-10.6-03](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mig-10-6-03)

### MIG-10.6-02 {#mig-10-6-02}

\[CONDITIONAL\] Where the deletion of key material and personal data from the source Wallet Unit has not been confirmed within a period defined and documented by the Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall revoke the source Wallet Unit irrespective of that confirmation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 93](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=93)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented period and confirming that a source Wallet Unit is revoked once the period has elapsed without the source device being reconnected. Where feasible, the CAB may also complete a migration in which the source device is never reconnected and confirm that the source Wallet Unit is revoked once the period has elapsed.



### MIG-10.6-03 {#mig-10-6-03}

\[CONDITIONAL\] Where the deletion of key material and personal data from the source Wallet Unit has been confirmed under [MIG-10.6-01](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mig-10-6-01), the Wallet Provider shall revoke the source Wallet Unit if it has not already been revoked.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 93](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=93)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented decommissioning path in clause 10.5 and confirming that, once deletion on the source device is confirmed, the source Wallet Unit's status changes to revoked without further Wallet User action, and that where the source Wallet Unit was already revoked no conflicting or duplicate revocation attempt is made. Where feasible, the CAB may also complete a migration through the clause 10.5 decommissioning path and confirm this behaviour.



## 10.7 Recovery to a New Device When the Source Device Is Unavailable

[Read section 10.7 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-10-7)

### MIG-10.7-01 {#mig-10-7-01}

\[CONDITIONAL\] Where the source Wallet Unit is no longer accessible to the Wallet User, the Wallet Provider shall enable the Wallet User to re-establish the Wallet Unit on a new device by restoring a Migration Object, without requiring any participation by the source device.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 94](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=94)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented recovery flow and confirming that a Wallet Unit can be re-established from a Migration Object with no action by the source device, for instance by inspecting the flow design and, where feasible, by performing a recovery on a new device while the source device is kept offline.



### MIG-10.7-02 {#mig-10-7-02}

The Wallet Provider shall require identity proofing at the assurance level applicable to initial PID issuance before any PID credential is re-issued during a recovery performed under this clause.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 94](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=94)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the recovery flow and confirming that PID re-issuance is preceded by identity proofing at the initial-issuance assurance level, for instance by inspecting the flow and proofing records and, where feasible, by attempting a recovery without valid proofing and confirming that no PID is re-issued.



### MIG-10.7-03 {#mig-10-7-03}

\[CONDITIONAL\] Where a recovery under this clause is performed and the source Wallet Unit is managed by the same Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall revoke the source Wallet Unit, treating the Wallet User’s assertion that the source device is no longer under their control as the trigger for that revocation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 94](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=94)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the recovery flow and confirming that completing a recovery revokes a source Wallet Unit managed by the same Wallet Provider without waiting for source-device confirmation, for instance by inspecting the flow and revocation records and, where feasible, by performing a recovery and confirming the source unit’s status becomes revoked.



### MIG-10.7-04 {#mig-10-7-04}

\[CONDITIONAL\] Where a recovery under this clause is performed and the source Wallet Unit is managed by a different Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall give the Wallet User the best possible instructions on the actions the Wallet User should undertake in order to get the source Wallet Unit revoked.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 95](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=95)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by performing a recovery in which the source Wallet Unit is managed by a different provider and confirming that the Wallet User is given actionable instructions on how to obtain that revocation, for instance by inspecting the recovery flow and the guidance presented to the Wallet User.



### MIG-10.7-05 {#mig-10-7-05}

The Wallet Provider shall apply to the re-establishment of the Wallet Unit on the new device under this clause the same new device security verification and reestablishment controls that apply to a migration, as set out in clauses 10.3 and 10.4.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 95](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=95)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the recovery flow and confirming that the new device security verification and the re-establishment controls of clauses 10.3 and 10.4 are applied before a Wallet Unit is re-established through recovery, for instance by inspecting the recovery flow design and, where feasible, by attempting a recovery onto a device that fails the security verification and confirming that re-establishment does not complete.



## 11.1 Wallet User-Initiated Uninstallation

[Read section 11.1 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-11-1)

### UNINST-11.1-01 {#uninst-11-1-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires an explicit confirmation step from the Wallet User before proceeding with uninstallation and presents the Wallet User with a clear statement of the consequences of uninstallation, including the irreversible loss of all key bound credentials stored in the Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 97](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=97)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by starting uninstallation on a test Wallet Unit and confirming that a consequence statement and an explicit confirmation step are presented before it proceeds.



### UNINST-11.1-02 {#uninst-11-1-02}

The Wallet Provider shall, prior to completing the Wallet Instance uninstallation process, inform the Wallet User that all PID credentials, attestations and transaction logs stored in the Wallet Unit will be permanently deleted and are not recoverable after uninstallation, and shall require explicit Wallet User confirmation before proceeding.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 97](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=97)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the uninstallation flow and confirming that a data loss warning with an explicit confirmation step is present, and that cancellation of the confirmation halts the uninstallation process without deleting any credentials.



### UNINST-11.1-03 {#uninst-11-1-03}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, prior to completing the Wallet Instance uninstallation process, an updated Migration Object is available in the storage location selected by the Wallet User, that the Wallet User confirms to still have access to that location and verify that the Wallet User still has knowledge of the Migration Object.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 98](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=98)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by running uninstallation with each check satisfied and confirming completion, and by removing access to the stored object and confirming the check detects it.

**Referenced by:** [UNINST-11.1-04](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#uninst-11-1-04)

### UNINST-11.1-04 {#uninst-11-1-04}

\[CONDITIONAL\] If one of the checks in [UNINST-11.1-03](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#uninst-11-1-03) is not met, the Wallet Provider shall ensure that Wallet Unit uninstallation only proceeds after renewed confirmation by the Wallet User.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 98](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=98)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by forcing one of the recovery checks to fail and confirming that uninstallation halts until the Wallet User provides a renewed confirmation.



## 11.2 Pre-Uninstallation Security Measures

[Read section 11.2 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-11-2)

### UNINST-11.2-01 {#uninst-11-2-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all active sessions and pending transactions within the Wallet Unit are terminated before the uninstallation process begins.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 98](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=98)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented uninstallation behaviour and confirming that an active session or transaction is terminated before deletion



### UNINST-11.2-02 {#uninst-11-2-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Provider backend is notified of the uninstallation event before or upon completion of the uninstallation process, enabling the Wallet Provider to initiate appropriate deregistration or revocation actions.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 99](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=99)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by uninstalling a test Wallet Unit and confirming that the backend receives the uninstallation notification and can act on it.



## 11.3 Data Cleanup and Deletion

[Read section 11.3 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-11-3)

### UNINST-11.3-01 {#uninst-11-3-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all private keys associated with the Wallet Unit, including keys attested in a Key Attestation, credential-binding keys, and Wallet User authentication keys, are irrecoverably deleted from the WSCD and from all application storage locations during uninstallation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 99](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=99)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by uninstalling a test Wallet Unit and confirming, by inspection of the device, that no associated private key material remains recoverable.



### UNINST-11.3-02 {#uninst-11-3-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all PID credentials and attestations stored in the Wallet Unit are irrecoverably deleted during uninstallation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 99](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=99)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented deletion steps of the uninstallation procedure and the storage locations they cover for held credentials,



### UNINST-11.3-03 {#uninst-11-3-03}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all cached data, temporary files, session tokens, and application state related to Wallet Unit operations are irrecoverably deleted during uninstallation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 100](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=100)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by uninstalling a test Wallet Unit and confirming that cached data, temporary files, session tokens, and application state have been removed.



### UNINST-11.3-04 {#uninst-11-3-04}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the WSCA and WSCD are cleared of all key material, configuration data, and application-specific data stored within them as part of the uninstallation process.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 100](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=100)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by uninstalling a test Wallet Unit and confirming that the secure cryptographic application and device no longer hold any Wallet-Unit key material, configuration, or data.



### UNINST-11.3-05 {#uninst-11-3-05}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon Wallet Instance uninstallation, all operational records and transaction logs associated with the uninstalled Wallet Unit that are held in the Wallet Provider's backend systems are either deleted or anonymised in accordance with the applicable data protection requirements, except where those records are required to be retained under a legal obligation, in which case the retained records shall be limited to what is strictly necessary, retained only for the minimum required period, and access-controlled to prevent use for any purpose other than compliance with that obligation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 100](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=100)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented data management policy and confirming that it includes procedures for handling transaction logs and operational records upon uninstallation, with enumerated record categories, documented legal bases, defined retention periods, and deletion mechanisms. The CAB may additionally verify the policy's implementation by reviewing records relating to previously uninstalled test Wallet Units and confirming deletion or anonymisation in accordance with the stated policy.



## 11.4 Revocation and Deregistration

[Read section 11.4 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-11-4)

### UNINST-11.4-01 {#uninst-11-4-01}

The Wallet Provider shall revoke the Wallet Instance Attestation and the Key Attestation associated with a Wallet Unit at the time of Wallet Instance uninstallation regardless of whether the Wallet User intends to install the Wallet Instance again on the same or a different device.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 101](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=101)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documentation to confirm that the maximum revocation publication delay is defined and monitored, and by checking the Wallet Unit Attestation status list to confirm that a WUA revocation is published within the defined maximum delay. Where feasible, the CAB may also uninstall the Wallet Instance from a test device and attempt to make a presentation using key material from the uninstalled Wallet Unit, confirming that the WUA is rejected as revoked by the status check.



## 11.5 Verification of Complete Removal

[Read section 11.5 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-11-5)

### UNINST-11.5-01 {#uninst-11-5-01}

The Wallet Provider shall provide the Wallet User with confirmation that the uninstallation process has completed, including confirmation that the Wallet Unit has been deregistered with the Wallet Provider and has been revoked.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 102](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=102)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by completing uninstallation and confirming that the Wallet User is shown confirmation covering deregistration and revocation.



### UNINST-11.5-02 {#uninst-11-5-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the uninstallation process results in no recoverable Wallet Unit data remaining on the device, including private keys, credentials, cached data, and application configuration files.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 102](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=102)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented deletion steps of the uninstallation procedure and the Wallet Unit data they cover, confirming that no recoverable Wallet Unit data remains. Where a forensic examination is feasible, the CAB may also inspect the device after uninstallation to confirm that no recoverable Wallet Unit data remains.



## 12.1 Revocation Triggers and Conditions

[Read section 12.1 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-12-1)

### REV-12.1-01 {#rev-12-1-01}

The Wallet Provider shall implement mechanisms to detect security breaches affecting Wallet Units, including monitoring for indicators of device compromise, and shall initiate revocation procedures upon confirmed detection of a breach affecting a Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 103](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=103)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the detection mechanisms and confirming that a confirmed breach affecting a test Wallet Unit triggers revocation.



### REV-12.1-02 {#rev-12-1-02}

The Wallet Provider shall revoke a Wallet Unit when required to do so by applicable law or by a competent supervisory authority, within the timeframes mandated by the applicable legal requirement.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 103](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=103)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the process for handling legally mandated revocations and confirming that it provides for action within the applicable statutory timeframes.



### REV-12.1-03 {#rev-12-1-03}

The Wallet Provider shall establish and maintain a documented procedure for accepting and processing requests for permanent revocation of a Wallet Unit submitted by an authorised party other than the Wallet Unit holder, including requests submitted in consequence of the death or legal incapacity of the natural person to whom the Wallet Unit is issued, and shall provide a mechanism that enables such requests to be submitted and verified without requiring participation of the Wallet Unit holder.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 103](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=103)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented procedure for third-party revocation requests and confirming that: (i) the procedure exists and covers the death and legal incapacity scenarios; (ii) it specifies acceptable verification instruments; (iii) it does not require participation by the Wallet Unit holder. The CAB may additionally submit a simulated third-party revocation request with appropriate documentation and verify that the request is processed and the Wallet Unit is revoked.

**Referenced by:** [REV-12.1-08](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#rev-12-1-08)

### REV-12.1-04 {#rev-12-1-04}

The Wallet Provider shall establish processes for Wallet Users or other competent parties to notify suspected device compromise.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 104](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=104)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by confirming that documented reporting routes exist for Wallet Users and other competent parties and that a submitted report reaches the Wallet Provider's revocation process.



### REV-12.1-05 {#rev-12-1-05}

The Wallet Provider shall revoke a Wallet Unit for which credible evidence of fraudulent use or sufficient indication of suspected compromise has been identified and shall record the basis and supporting evidence for the revocation decision.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 104](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=104)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing revocation records and confirming that revocations on grounds of fraud or suspected compromise are supported by a recorded basis and evidence.



### REV-12.1-06 {#rev-12-1-06}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a Wallet User can initiate revocation of their own Wallet Unit through a means that does not depend on access to the Wallet Unit’s device, on authentication factors or credentials that are typically kept or carried together with that device, or on any secret or credential that the Wallet User would typically only store in a fixed location such as their home.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 105](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=105)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet User-initiated revocation design and confirming that at least one route does not depend on the device, on credentials typically lost with it, or on a secret the Wallet User would keep only at a fixed location such as home, for instance by inspecting the design and, where feasible, by initiating revocation from a different device, and from a different location, without the original authentication means.



### REV-12.1-07 {#rev-12-1-07}

The Wallet Provider shall, after authenticating the PID Provider as the sender, revoke a Wallet Unit when the PID Provider forwards a request for revocation of that Wallet Unit on behalf of the person in whose name a PID was issued to it.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 105](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=105)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the interface and its authentication and by examining records of requests received and the revocations that followed.



### REV-12.1-08 {#rev-12-1-08}

The Wallet Provider shall treat a notice from the PID Provider of the decease of a Wallet Holder as a request under [REV-12.1-03](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#rev-12-1-03) for permanent revocation of the Wallet Unit to which the notice relates.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 105](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=105)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the procedure and by examining records of past notices.



## 12.2 Revocation Procedures
