[Read section 12.2 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-12-2)

### REV-12.2-01 {#rev-12-2-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that revocation requests submitted by parties other than the Wallet User are subject to verification of the authority of the requesting party to trigger revocation before the request is acted upon.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 106](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=106)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by submitting third-party revocation requests with and without demonstrated authority and confirming that only the authorised request is acted upon.



### REV-12.2-02 {#rev-12-2-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a revoked Wallet Unit is disabled within a defined maximum timeframe following the revocation decision.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 106](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=106)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented revocation mechanism and confirming that a triggered revocation disables the Wallet Unit within the defined maximum timeframe, corroborating this against revocation records. Where feasible, the CAB may also trigger a revocation and confirm that the Wallet Unit is disabled within the defined maximum timeframe.



### REV-12.2-03 {#rev-12-2-03}

The Wallet Provider shall document and enforce that maximum permissible delay between the revocation decision and the effective disabling of the Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 107](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=107)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented maximum delay and confirming, against revocation records, that the effective disabling times observed fall within it.



### REV-12.2-04 {#rev-12-2-04}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon revocation of a Wallet Unit, the revocation status of the associated Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation is published to the applicable revocation status mechanism without undue delay, enabling parties interacting with the Wallet Unit to detect the revocation prior to accepting transactions with the revoked Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 107](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=107)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented maximum publishing delay and corroborating, against revocation records, that revocation status becomes observable through the applicable status mechanism within that delay. Where feasible, the CAB may also revoke a Wallet Unit and measure the time until the revocation status is observable, confirming it falls within the documented maximum publishing delay.



### REV-12.2-05 {#rev-12-2-05}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance ceases to display the European Digital Identity Wallet Trust Mark referred to in \[13\] from the moment the Wallet Instance Attestation of that Wallet Unit is revoked.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 107](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=107)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented Trust Mark behaviour and confirming that the Trust Mark is no longer displayed once a Wallet Unit is revoked. Where feasible, the CAB may also revoke a test Wallet Unit and confirm, on the device, that the Trust Mark is no longer displayed.



### REV-12.2-06 {#rev-12-2-06}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that revocation of a Wallet Unit is permanent and irreversible, and shall not provide any mechanism, interface, process, or administrative function through which a permanently revoked Wallet Unit can be restored to an active or operational state.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 108](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=108)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's system documentation and confirming the absence of any functionality that permits reversal of permanent revocation. The CAB also attempts to re-activate a test Wallet Unit that has been permanently revoked and confirms that no pathway — including administrative or technical — allows this. The CAB additionally reviews the Wallet Provider's access control documentation to confirm that no personnel role has the capability to reverse a permanent revocation.



### REV-12.2-07 {#rev-12-2-07}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance Attestation issued to each Wallet Unit contains a reference to the revocation status mechanism maintained by the Wallet Provider, enabling relying parties and PID Providers to determine the current revocation status of the Wallet Unit at the time of any transaction.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 109](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=109)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by inspecting the WUA of a test Wallet Unit and confirming the presence of a revocation status mechanism reference. The CAB then uses that reference to query the revocation status of the Wallet Unit and confirms that the response correctly reflects the Wallet Unit's current status, including after the test Wallet Unit has been permanently revoked. The CAB also confirms that the revocation status endpoint is publicly accessible without requiring authentication.



### REV-12.2-08 {#rev-12-2-08}

The Wallet Provider shall, whenever it revokes the Wallet Instance Attestation of a Wallet Unit — on revocation of the Wallet Unit under this clause, on uninstallation of the Wallet Instance, or on revocation of a source Wallet Unit during migration — set to revoked the revocation status of every Wallet Instance Attestation it has issued to that Wallet Unit, including any such attestation whose technical validity period has expired but whose revocation status the Wallet Provider still maintains, so that the revocation status reference recorded by a PID Provider or Attestation Provider at issuance reflects the revocation throughout the lifetime of the PID or attestation issued against it.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 109](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=109)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented revocation procedure and confirming that a single revocation action sets to revoked the status of every Wallet Instance Attestation issued to the Wallet Unit, including those past their technical validity period whose status is still maintained, and by inspecting revocation records for a revoked Wallet Unit to confirm that the status list entries of its earlier, expired Wallet Instance Attestations were also set. Where feasible, the CAB may issue to a test Wallet Unit more than one Wallet Instance Attestation, allow the earlier attestation to expire, revoke the Wallet Unit, and confirm that both the expired and the current entries reflect revocation within the maximum publication delay documented under [REV-12.3-01](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#rev-12-3-01).



## 12.3 Impact on PIDs and Attestations

[Read section 12.3 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-12-3)

### REV-12.3-01 {#rev-12-3-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the revocation status of the Wallet Instance Attestation and of the Key Attestation is published to the applicable attestation status list within a defined and documented maximum time period following the triggering event for revocation, and shall make that attestation status list available in a format and at a location that enables PID Providers and Attestation Providers to query the revocation status of any such attestation without requiring authenticated access to the status service.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 110](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=110)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented maximum revocation publication delay for each trigger type and confirming, against revocation records, that the updated revocation status is published on the status list within that delay and that the status list is accessible without authentication. Where feasible, the CAB may also trigger a test revocation, measure the time between the trigger event and publication of the updated status, and attempt to access the status list without authentication, confirming that the query succeeds and returns the correct status for the revoked Wallet Unit Attestation.

**Referenced by:** [REV-12.2-08](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#rev-12-2-08)

### REV-12.3-02 {#rev-12-3-02}

\[CONDITIONAL\] Where the Wallet Instance Attestation or the Key Attestation is issued in the mobile document format specified in \[11\], the Wallet Provider shall publish its revocation status by means of an attestation status list or an attestation revocation list as specified in \[12\].

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 111](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=111)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by determining the format of the attestations issued in production, retrieving the published status information, and confirming that its representation is the one specified for that format.



### REV-12.3-03 {#rev-12-3-03}

\[CONDITIONAL\] Where the Wallet Instance Attestation or the Key Attestation is issued in the selectively disclosable JSON Web Token verifiable credential format, the Wallet Provider shall publish its revocation status by means of an attestation status list as specified in \[10\].

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 111](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=111)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by retrieving the status information referenced by an attestation issued in this format and confirming that it is a status list in the specified representation.



## 12.4 Data Deletion Requirements

[Read section 12.4 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-12-4)

### REV-12.4-01 {#rev-12-4-01}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all private keys stored in the remote WSCD that are associated with a revoked Wallet Unit are irrecoverably deleted and that the revocation event is recorded in a tamper-evident audit log.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 112](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=112)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented server-side key handling and confirming that revocation of a Wallet Unit whose keys are held server-side deletes those keys and that a tamper-evident log entry records the revocation. Where feasible, the CAB may also revoke a test Wallet Unit whose keys are held server-side and confirm that those keys are deleted and that a tamper-evident log entry records the revocation.



### REV-12.4-02 {#rev-12-4-02}

The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, following permanent revocation of a Wallet Unit, all personal data associated with the revoked Wallet Unit that is held in the Wallet Provider's backend systems is deleted or anonymised in accordance with the applicable data protection requirements, except where those records are required to be retained under a legal obligation, in which case the retained data shall be limited to what is strictly necessary, retained only for the minimum required period, and access-controlled to prevent use for any purpose other than compliance with that obligation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 112](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=112)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the Wallet Provider's documented data retention policy for the post-revocation period and confirming that: (i) categories of retained data are enumerated with a documented legal basis and defined retention period for each; (ii) deletion or anonymisation is triggered at the end of the retention period; (iii) access to retained data is restricted to the specific compliance purpose. The CAB may additionally review records relating to previously revoked test Wallet Units to confirm that retention and deletion are applied in accordance with the documented policy.



### REV-12.4-03 {#rev-12-4-03}

The Wallet Provider shall retain audit logs related to Wallet Unit revocation for a period sufficient to support legal proceedings, supervisory audit, and incident investigation, and shall ensure that the retention period does not exceed the maximum period permitted under applicable data protection law.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 113](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=113)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the retention policy for revocation logs and confirming that the period is sufficient for the stated purposes and does not exceed the maximum permitted by applicable data protection law.



## 13.1 General Monitoring and Fraud Detection

[Read section 13.1 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-13-1)

### MON-13.1-01 {#mon-13-1-01}

The Wallet Provider shall operate a monitoring capability that detects, across every lifecycle state of a Wallet Unit, patterns indicative of compromise or fraudulent use in the backend interactions it receives from that Wallet Unit, including a frequency of those interactions inconsistent with normal operation and a device or Wallet Secure Cryptographic Device profile presented in an interaction that is inconsistent with the profile recorded for that Wallet Unit at activation or at a subsequent re-attestation.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 114](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=114)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the monitoring design and the backend interactions it consumes, and by reproducing each listed condition — an abnormal interaction frequency and a mismatched device profile — against a test Wallet Unit and confirming that the monitoring capability records it.

**Referenced by:** [MON-13.1-02](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mon-13-1-02), [MON-13.2-01](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mon-13-2-01), [MON-13.2-02](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mon-13-2-02)

### MON-13.1-02 {#mon-13-1-02}

The Wallet Provider shall document, for each anomaly condition detected under [MON-13.1-01](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mon-13-1-01), the investigation procedure applied and the response available, up to and including revocation of the Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 114](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=114)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented conditions and responses, and by sampling recorded anomalies to confirm that the response actually applied was the documented one.



### MON-13.1-03 {#mon-13-1-03}

The Wallet Provider shall provide the Wallet User with a means of reporting suspected compromise or misuse of a Wallet Unit that does not require the Wallet User to authenticate to that Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 115](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=115)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by locating the reporting channel as a Wallet User would, submitting a test report without authenticating to the Wallet Unit, and confirming that the report reaches the monitoring or support function.



## 13.2 State-Specific Monitoring Inputs

[Read section 13.2 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-13-2)

### MON-13.2-01 {#mon-13-2-01}

\[CONDITIONAL\] For a Wallet Unit that holds no PID credential, the Wallet Provider shall base the monitoring required under [MON-13.1-01](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mon-13-1-01) on the Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation status queries, the software update check-ins, and the reports of suspected compromise that it receives from the Wallet Unit at that stage.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 115](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=115)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reproducing each listed condition — an abnormal query frequency and a mismatched device profile — against a test Wallet Unit that holds no PID credential and confirming that the monitoring capability records it.



### MON-13.2-02 {#mon-13-2-02}

\[CONDITIONAL\] For a Wallet Unit that holds a PID credential, the Wallet Provider shall extend the monitoring required under [MON-13.1-01](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mon-13-1-01) to the trust anchor distribution channel, the software update check-ins, and any migration-initiation request it receives from the Wallet Unit.

**Requirement** · obligation: **conditional** · [PDF page 116](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=116)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reproducing an anomalous condition — an abnormal trust anchor distribution or migration-initiation pattern — on a test Wallet Unit that holds a PID credential and confirming that the monitoring capability records it.



## 13.3 Monitoring of the Application and Web Ecosystem

[Read section 13.3 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-13-3)

### MON-13.3-01 {#mon-13-3-01}

The Wallet Provider shall monitor the application distribution channels through which the Wallet Instance is made available for counterfeit, modified, or look-alike applications that impersonate the Wallet Instance.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 116](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=116)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented monitoring process and its coverage of the distribution channels through which the Wallet Instance is offered, and by reviewing records of counterfeit applications identified over a representative period.

**Referenced by:** [MON-13.3-02](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mon-13-3-02)

### MON-13.3-02 {#mon-13-3-02}

The Wallet Provider shall, upon identifying a counterfeit, modified, or lookalike application that impersonates the Wallet Instance, pursue its removal from the application distribution channel on which it is offered.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 117](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=117)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing records of counterfeit applications identified under [MON-13.3-01](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mon-13-3-01) and confirming that a removal request was raised for each and pursued to a recorded outcome.



### MON-13.3-03 — The Wallet Provider shall monitor for websites that impersonate the Wallet Provider in order to deceive Wallet Users. {#mon-13-3-03}

The Wallet Provider shall monitor for websites that impersonate the Wallet Provider in order to deceive Wallet Users.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 117](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=117)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented monitoring process and reviewing records of impersonation websites identified over a representative period.

**Referenced by:** [MON-13.3-04](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mon-13-3-04)

### MON-13.3-04 {#mon-13-3-04}

The Wallet Provider shall, upon identifying a website that impersonates the Wallet Provider or the Wallet Instance, pursue its takedown.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 117](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=117)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing records of impersonation websites identified under [MON-13.3-03](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/nl-p-04w#mon-13-3-03) and confirming that a takedown request was raised for each and pursued to a recorded outcome.



## 13.4 Wallet User Warning Channel

[Read section 13.4 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-04w#s-13-4)

### MON-13.4-01 {#mon-13-4-01}

The Wallet Provider shall maintain a means of contacting the Wallet User over a push channel that the Wallet User will see without opening the Wallet Instance and that is independent of the Wallet Instance, for use in warning the Wallet User when compromise of the Wallet Unit is suspected.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 118](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-04W_Wallet_Onboarding__Lifecycle_Mngt_-_reqs_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=118)

**How a CAB verifies this:** A CAB verifies this requirement by reviewing the documented contact channel and confirming it is independent of the Wallet Instance and that it actively pushes a warning rather than waiting to be read, so that a suspected compromise warning reaches the Wallet User without the Wallet Instance being opened and without the Wallet User having to open a portal or inbox to find it. Where feasible, the CAB may also trigger a test suspected-compromise warning and confirm that it reaches the Wallet User in this way.
